ITEM PARAGRAPHS
The
"
Festival
in
The
Desert
"
is
a
celebration
of
the
musical
heritage
of
the
Touareg
,
a
fiercely
independent
nomadic
people
.
It
is
held
annually
near
Essakane
,
an
oasis
some
40
miles
north-west
of
Timbuktu
,
the
ancient
city
on
the
Niger
River
.
Reaching
it
tests
endurance
,
with
miles
of
impermanent
sand
tracks
to
negotiate
.
The
reward
of
navigating
this
rough
terrain
comes
in
the
form
of
a
three-day
feast
of
music
and
dance
.
